scope: One dated, publicly retrievable original broker PDF was archived for each provisional evidence-test ticker. This is a broker-evidence packet, not a licensed all-Street consensus dataset and not a valuation anchor.
governance_boundary: All rows have valuation_weight 0.00. Five reports state a rating and earnings forecasts but no explicit target price; no target is inferred from displayed P/E. The sole explicit target (688506) is dated 2025-02-28, materially predates the case cutoff, and is retained only as stale historical broker evidence. No row can support a company rating, a current target, a current upside calculation, or a core-pool valuation.

summary.zero_weight_reason: No company-level customer/order/ASP/utilization/margin/cash bridge or frozen current-price valuation package is complete; most reports also lack an explicit target price.

key_consensus_views: This packet does not estimate a Street consensus because it has one selected report per ticker, not a licensed or complete multi-broker population.
The available reports offer forecast context only; they do not cure the case's missing company-level evidence and valuation gates.
key_divergence_points: Semiconductor equipment forecasts depend on fab capex, qualification and delivery/acceptance, which are not closed in the case.
Innovative-drug forecast and BD headlines must be separated from asset-level accounting, probability and cash realisation.
Power-equipment trend and forecast require tender share, order conversion, receivable/cash and margin evidence before valuation use.
